character.locked_description: Kabir is a 10-year-old South Asian boy with a slight build, warm brown skin, and short cropped black hair. His round face features dark eyes and a straight nose. He wears a #3F7D4E green bomber jacket over a #F2E8CF off-white t-shirt, paired with khaki cargo shorts and scuffed canvas sneakers. A canvas satchel covered in colorful embroidered patches rests across his chest. In his hand, he holds his totem, a brass folding ruler clicked open into a triangle. At rest, he stands with his weight shifted to one leg, his shoulders relaxed, and his hands lightly gripping the edges of his brass ruler.
